title: Virtual keyboard hides when submitting text when `keep_editing_on_text_submit` is enabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.beta1+
- Not reproducible in 4.4.dev7 and lower, because `keep_editing_on_text_submit` not existed then

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 05 May 2025 14:13:34 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1235U (12 threads)

### Issue description

When pressing Enter on virtual keyboard (or tick in one line mode), it hides when `keep_editing_on_text_submit` is enabled.
The core problem is this lines
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8f78e7510d2d7ff5ac5025d1949b9696aafe0a68/scene/gui/line_edit.cpp#L875-L878
Adding `!keep_editing_on_text_submit` in condition fixes this, but another problems arise
After hitting Enter on Gboard, LineEdit stops receiving Unicode input (but still receives ASCII), and Enter icon changes from tick to default Enter sign.
Another tested keyboard just disappears by itself.
Looks like multiline flag is needed in every mode with `keep_editing_on_text_submit`, but this requires changing Java APIs.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create LineEdit and enable `keep_editing_on_text_submit`.
2. Open on some device with virtual keyboard and press Enter.
3. Notice virtual keyboard disappeared.
